pages.text: $(l)Keep stockpiled depleted fuels$()—LEU-235, LEP-239, HEA-242, LEB-248, and some LE-FHM—on hand. All other fuels can be produced via passive or automated chains once progression unlocks them.

$(l)Salt reactor stability tips$()$(li)A 3-slice stable lymph salt reactor powers three miners comfortably (each miner uses 50 mB of vital lymph per 40 s).$(li)Molten polonium $(o)can$() be used safely in the safe vital lymph salt reactor, but only if both fuel rows are maintained to prevent shutdown.
$(li)You may skip polonium entirely—it is optional and not required for progression.

$(l)Fuel handling & breeding$()$(li)Build robust depleted HEA-242 production early to avoid bottlenecks in enrichment.$(li)Monitor fission breeding buffers closely: if full, californium-250 production halts and unidentified ingot progress stalls.
$(li)Recycle NaK to efficiently handle hot molten salt mixtures for reuse.
